headline: Approved $19,500 McPhail Associates proposal for additional borings to support switch to timber piles
summary: The Malden River Works Salt Shed & Boathouse committee approved the 9/3/26 meeting minutes and approved a $19,500 proposal from McPhail Associates for additional subsurface borings to support switching to timber piles. Members discussed starting borings at the boathouse and noted the Phase 1 grand opening is set for October 4.
decisions: Approved the McPhail Associates proposal dated 9/14/26 for additional borings, for a lump sum fee of $19,500, unanimously via roll call vote.

Committee to Approve Minutes

 Deb motioned to approve the 9/3/26 minutes. Steve seconded the motion, and the Committee 
voted unanimously to approve the minutes.
Malden River Works Salt Shed & Boathouse Project Updates
Committee to review and approve a proposal (dated 9/14/26 from McPhail Associates, attached) for 
additional boring prior to bidding in order to facilitate the switch to timber piles.
 The proposal requests approval to do additional subsurface investigation at the proposed 
structures to further delineate the soil conditions through the full length of the timber piles
 McPhail will perform 2-3 borings to document the subsurface soil and groundwater conditions, 
40-60 feet down or to practical refusal, whichever happens first
 Borings will take 2 days to complete, but McPhail needs 6-7 weeks from approval for the report 
because driller books 3-4 weeks out and then the report will take 2-3 weeks to write
 Lump sum fee for everything is $19,500

 Steve noted that McPhail should start borings at the boathouse, as that is the location where no 
boring data exists currently
 The group agreed that these additional borings are necessary to ensure that project costs are as 
low as possible (if timber piles don’t work, the alternatives are much more expensive)
 Steve motioned to approve the proposal. Peg seconded the motion, and the motion was 
unanimously approved via roll call vote.
 Nelson will sign the proposal as chair.

N/A
New Business
 The grand opening for Malden River Works “phase 1” is Sunday, October 4 from 1-4PM.
 Eric noted that he participated in the landscaping walkthrough for Phase 1 last week and everything 
looked good.
Adjournment
Eric motioned to adjourn the meeting. Paul seconded the motion and the motion passed via unanimous vote.
